category_title: Verbal students with autism who engage in stereotypic behavior and proximity issues
scenario_title: Sustaining reciprocal conversation in general education class
minimal_context: Harold is practicing reciprocal conversation skills using his communication book with a tutor before his general education Spanish class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Harold, let's use your communication book to practice having a conversation before Spanish class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Rubs his arms) When I go to Spanish. We just talk. I like to ask them what is your favorite movie or I like to ask them what are your plans for the weekends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That's right. What do you want to ask me?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands uncomfortably close) What is your favorite animated movie? I saw a cartoon character on a backpack.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's try talking about something else.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts picking at his skin and rubbing his knuckles, engaging in self-talk) Animated movies... cartoons...
